name: gerd overview
title: GERD decision chart: classic heartburn or regurgitation without alarm features is a clinical diagnosis treated with lifestyle change then acid suppression; alarm features or Barrett's risk factors send the patient to endoscopy; failure of a PPI or diagnostic uncertainty leads to ambulatory pH monitoring and manometry

root.title: Heartburn or regurgitation: treat it as GERD, or does it need a SCOPE?
lines: gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a CLINICAL diagnosis: classic symptoms + NO alarm features ± response to a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) trial
endoscopy does NOT diagnose GERD: it looks for complications and other diagnoses

groups.title: ENDOSCOPY if ANY of these
lines: • alarm features or Barrett's risk factors

head: h
Typical GERD
erosive esophagitis or non-erosive reflux disease (NERD)
tx: • raise the head of the bed, no late meals

head: h
Cancer or Barrett's?
look for complications
pres: • GI cancer in a first-degree relative
• obesity, hiatal hernia, nocturnal reflux, smoking
tx: see the LUMINAL GI MALIGNANCIES lecture

head: h
Refractory or uncertain
no response to a standard-dose PPI
inv: the BEST test: workup normal + failed PPI trial
